title_en: In the Center, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Totally Invested for Sale!!
description_en: In the Center, Near Turdiu Center, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Fully Invested for sale. The apartment has a gross area of ​​120 m2, net 107 m2 and is located on the top floor of a well-managed 7-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom with access to the second balcony, a children's room and two toilets. The apartment is fully invested, starting with plumbing and electrical installations, plastering, plaster ceilings, LED lighting, quality parquet, contemporary furniture, etc. The apartment is located in one of the most popular areas of Tirana, offering all the facilities for a comfortable life. Immediate access to the center. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
